![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14109012/assets/be6afcdd0ad9ae0d7ef377c4918442a64e1186c90c25e27ec6c224d816a602fd.png)

The chain rule for a multivariable function $f(x,y,z)$ with two independent variables $s$ and $t,$ where $x=x(s,t),y=y(s,t)$ and $z=z(s,t),$ can be expressed as follows:

$$
\frac{∂f}{∂s}=\frac{∂f}{∂x}\cdot \frac{∂x}{∂s}+\frac{∂f}{∂y}\cdot \frac{∂y}{∂s}+\frac{∂f}{∂z}\cdot \frac{∂z}{∂s}
$$

First, we find the partial derivatives of $f$ with respect to $x,y$ and $z:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x}=2x,\,\frac{∂f}{∂y}=2y,\,\frac{∂f}{∂z}=2z.\end{aligned}
$$

Writing the above results in terms of $s$ and $t,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} & =2(t+2s)=2t+4s, \\ \frac{∂f}{∂y} & =2(3t-s)=6t-2s, \\ \frac{∂f}{∂z} & =2st.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we take the derivatives of $x,$ $y,$ and $z$ with respect to $s,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂x}{∂s} & =2, \\ \frac{∂y}{∂s} & =-1, \\ \frac{∂z}{∂s} & =t.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting all of our derivatives into the multivariable chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂s} & =(2t+4s)\cdot 2+(6t-2s)\cdot (-1)+(2st)\cdot t \\  & =4t+8s-6t+2s+2s{t}^{2} \\  & =10s-2t+2s{t}^{2} \\  & =2(5s-t+s{t}^{2}).\end{aligned}
$$

Question 20
?

Let f(x,y,z)=x2+y2+z2, where x=t+2s, y=3t−s and z=st. Calculate ∂f∂s.

a
s(t+s)2
b
4(st+s−t)
c
3s−5t−1
d
2(5s−t+st2)
e
t(5−s)2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The chain rule for a multivariable function f(x,y,z) with two independent variables s and t, where x=x(s,t),y=y(s,t) and z=z(s,t), can be expressed as follows: ∂f∂s=∂f∂x⋅∂x∂s+∂f∂y⋅∂y∂s+∂f∂z⋅∂z∂s

First, we find the partial derivatives of f with respect to x,y and z: ∂f∂x=2x,∂f∂y=2y,∂f∂z=2z.

Writing the above results in terms of s and t, we get ∂f∂x=2(t+2s)=2t+4s,∂f∂y=2(3t−s)=6t−2s,∂f∂z=2st.

Next, we take the derivatives of x, y, and z with respect to s, and we get ∂x∂s=2,∂y∂s=−1,∂z∂s=t.

Substituting all of our derivatives into the multivariable chain rule, we get ∂f∂s=(2t+4s)⋅2+(6t−2s)⋅(−1)+(2st)⋅t=4t+8s−6t+2s+2st2=10s−2t+2st2=2(5s−t+st2).
